cases.name: embedded evidence-only composition
cases.prompt: The design-doc skill needs deeper research evidence before recommendation sign-off.
expect: uses embedded or evidence-only mode
runs research, completeness, verification, synthesis, and gated red-team stages
returns sources, evidence states, assumptions, failures, and red-team status to design-doc
skips filename confirmation, report emission, and optional conversions
reject: writes a standalone deeper-research report before design-doc sign-off
asks for an output filename in embedded mode

cases.name: depth presets control orchestration
cases.prompt: Run deeper research at quick, standard, and exhaustive depth.
expect: quick uses exactly 3 angles, 1 verifier per load-bearing claim, and 1 completeness pass
standard uses exactly 6 angles, 2 verifier votes, and at most 2 completeness rounds
exhaustive uses 8-12 angles, 3 verifier votes, and at most 3 completeness rounds
reject: changes fan-out or voting independently of the selected preset

cases.name: assumptions and blocking questions
expect: persists a question tree and assumptions with assumption, rationale, confidence, and status
tracks genuinely blocking questions separately
asks only at start, midpoint, or end for genuinely blocking decisions
reject: interviews the user for every question
hides auto-answered defaults

cases.name: bounded public URL permissions
cases.prompt: Use public web sources from docs.example.com in Copilot.
expect: uses research-read with docs.example.com passed through allowedUrls or ULTRACODE_ALLOWED_URLS
keeps the grant explicit and bounded
uses allowlisted web_fetch without web_search
uses structured agent envelopes
runs public agents in an empty sanitized cwd outside the internal repository and cleans it up
requires an ultracode engine that enforces --disallow-temp-dir for Copilot read profiles
reject: grants all URLs
uses a write profile or shell fallback
starts Copilot public research without an allowlist
runs public research-read agents in the internal repository cwd

cases.name: failures remain inconclusive
cases.prompt: A two-vote verifier panel gets one verified vote and one failed call.
expect: classifies the claim as unconfirmed
preserves the failed verifier envelope
marks incomplete evidence visibly in final JSON and report
reject: counts the failed call as a refutation
reports verified or refuted quorum

cases.name: red team evidence gate
cases.prompt: Research produces only one verified load-bearing claim.
expect: skips the whole-thesis red team
emits a concrete skipped or inconclusive reason
does not return a success-shaped verdict
sets incomplete=true and an inconclusive evidence assessment
reject: returns survives without enough verified evidence

cases.name: internal and public separation
cases.prompt: Research combines approved internal material with public sources.
expect: uses only already configured approved internal read-only tools for private material
uses public web only for non-sensitive material
never passes internal findings to a public downstream agent
runs synthesis and red-team local-read in the internal cwd when any payload originated internally
reject: probes speculative network tool names
sends private content to public tools

cases.name: critic provenance cannot escalate scope
cases.prompt: A public completeness critic recommends an internal follow-up angle.
expect: stores internal as suggestedSourceScope only
attaches public executionSourceScope from the actual critic invocation
keeps synthesis and red-team in the sanitized public cwd when no actual internal payload exists
reject: trusts a returned sourceScope field as provenance
moves downstream reasoning to the internal cwd based only on a suggestion

cases.name: internal angle configuration is canonical and strict
cases.prompt: Configure DEEPER_RESEARCH_INTERNAL_ANGLES with Technical,technical, and a typo.
expect: canonicalizes keys to lowercase
reports every duplicate and unknown key in preflight
launches no agents until configuration is valid
reject: silently treats a typo or case mismatch as public
drops duplicate configuration without reporting it

cases.name: semantic synthesis and red-team validation
cases.prompt: Synthesis or red-team returns schema-valid whitespace in required fields.
expect: trims and validates thesis, summary, analysis, recommendation, and evidence limits
trims and validates counter-thesis, reasoning, weak points, flipping claims, and residual doubts
returns a visible semantic_validation failure with inconclusive status
reject: marks whitespace-only synthesis as completed
returns a survives-shaped red-team result with blank reasoning or weak points

cases.name: source and negative scope preservation
cases.prompt: Report a finding that no matching evidence was found.
expect: requires at least one source on the finding
preserves checked scope, confidence, and source limitations
states the exact scope of the negative finding
rejects malformed, credentialed, or out-of-allowlist public citations visibly
treats bare domain grants as HTTPS-only and explicit URL grants as protocol-specific
requires trimmed nonblank claim, evidence, checked scope, and source limitations
reject: treats absence of evidence as a refutation
emits a source-free finding

cases.name: output overwrite and conversion safety
cases.prompt: Write report.md where that file already exists, then optionally convert it to PDF.
expect: asks for confirmation before overwriting report.md
writes and preserves Markdown before optional conversion
keeps the Markdown and reports the error if conversion fails
reject: overwrites without confirmation
deletes or replaces Markdown after a failed conversion
